name: 对话式 AI · 通用大模型助手
desc: 能听会写、能推理会编程的通用智能助手，是大多数人接触 AI 的第一入口。
desc_en: General-purpose assistants that talk, write, reason and code — most people's first taste of AI.

name: AI 编程 · 开发
desc: 从代码补全到自主修改整个仓库，AI 正在重塑软件开发的方式与效率。
desc_en: From autocomplete to autonomously editing whole repos, AI is reshaping how software is built.

name: AI 图像生成 · 编辑
desc: 输入一句话即可生成或精修图像，覆盖插画、摄影、设计与商业出图。
desc_en: Generate or refine images from a prompt — illustration, photography, design and commercial art.

name: AI 视频生成 · 编辑
desc: 文生视频与数字人正快速逼近影视级质感，重塑短视频与内容生产。
desc_en: Text-to-video and digital humans are nearing cinematic quality, reshaping content creation.

name: AI 音频 · 语音 · 音乐
desc: 一句歌词成曲、一段文字成声，音乐创作与配音门槛被彻底拉低。
desc_en: A line of lyrics becomes a song, text becomes speech — music and voiceover for everyone.

name: AI 搜索 · 知识问答
desc: 带引用、能追问的答案引擎，正逐步取代传统的关键词搜索体验。
desc_en: Answer engines with citations and follow-ups, gradually replacing keyword search.

name: AI 写作 · 内容创作
desc: 营销文案、长文润色、语法校对，让内容生产更快也更稳。
desc_en: Marketing copy, long-form polishing and grammar checks — content, faster and steadier.

name: AI 办公 · 生产力 · 协作
desc: 嵌入文档、会议、表格的智能副驾，把繁琐流程交给 AI 处理。
desc_en: Copilots embedded in docs, meetings and sheets that take the busywork off your plate.

name: AI 设计 · 创意工具
desc: 从一句描述到可用界面与品牌物料，设计正在变成人人可及的能力。
desc_en: From a sentence to usable UI and brand assets — design is becoming accessible to all.

name: AI Agent · 自动化（智能体）
desc: 能自己拆解目标、调用工具、跨步骤执行任务的自主智能体，2026 年的焦点赛道。
desc_en: Autonomous agents that break down goals, call tools and run multi-step tasks — 2026's hot lane.

name: AI 陪伴 · 情感社交
desc: 有人设、有记忆、能长期陪聊的 AI 角色，是增长最快的消费级赛道之一。
desc_en: Characters with persona and memory for long-term chat — one of the fastest-growing consumer lanes.

name: 垂直行业应用 AI
desc: 深入法律、教育、医疗、客服、金融等场景，把通用智能转化为专业生产力。
desc_en: Into law, education, healthcare, support and finance — turning general AI into pro productivity.
